gripOrHq.title: Paris City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Paris City Grid when you rez it. Use these bits only to pay for traces made during runs on this fort. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: Netwatch Operations Office
gripOrHq.rulesText: [A]: Trace 2 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

gripOrHq.title: Closed Accounts
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner loses all bits.

gripOrHq.title: Dr. Dreff
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever Runner makes a successful run on this fort, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

gripOrHq.title: Hunting Pack
gripOrHq.rulesText: For each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Hunting Pack, Hunting Pack has one subroutine as follows: "*Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag."

gripOrHq.title: Fetch 4.0.1
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put 15 from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
[A]: Take 3 from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Codecracker
rig.rulesText:
0 credits: Break code gate subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rig.title: Raptor
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break sentry subroutine.
1 credit: +1 strength.

rig.title: Worm
rig.rulesText:
0 credits: Break wall subroutine.
3 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Rigged Investments
rig.rulesText: Put 12 credits from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take 1 credit from Rigged Investments. When all credits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

ice.title: Banpei
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
